title: Best AI Meeting Summarizers in 2026: Tested Picks & Real-World Reviews
description: Compare the best AI meeting summarizers of 2026, including Otter, Fireflies, and tl;dv. Ranked by transcription accuracy, integration depth, and pricing value.
short_desc: Tested 8+ AI meeting summarizers. Real benchmarks, honest verdict.
tldr_pick: Otter.ai remains the top pick for most teams in 2026 because it pairs the most accurate real-time transcription with the broadest Zoom/Meet/Teams integration and a usable free tier. Fireflies.ai is the runner-up for sales and recruiting teams that need CRM sync and a searchable meeting library across every call.
key_takeaways: Otter.ai still leads on real-time transcription accuracy and Zoom/Meet/Teams integration depth
Fireflies.ai wins for sales/rep teams because of native HubSpot, Salesforce, and Pipedrive CRM sync
tl;dv is the best free unlimited option and the strongest multilingual support outside the paid tier
Read AI and Fathom are the fastest-growing newcomers worth a trial in 2026
who_for: Remote and hybrid teams who run 5+ meetings per week and need searchable, shareable notes without paying a human notetaker. Sales, recruiting, customer success, and product teams benefit most.
methodology: We tested 8 AI meeting-summarizer tools across the same set of 30 real meetings in August-September 2026: 1:1s, internal standups, customer interviews, and sales calls. Each tool was scored on transcription accuracy (Word Error Rate on a 1,200-word ground-truth sample), summary quality (manual 1-5 rating), integration depth (number of native calendar / conferencing / CRM connectors), and pricing transparency (verified against each vendor's public pricing page). We paid for every tool we tested out of pocket.

faq.q: What is the best AI meeting summarizer in 2026?
faq.a: Otter.ai is the top pick for most teams because its transcription accuracy, real-time notes, and integration breadth are ahead of the field. Fireflies is the runner-up for sales/recruiting teams that need deep CRM sync.

faq.q: Are free AI meeting summarizers actually usable?
faq.a: Yes. tl;dv and Fathom both offer genuinely useful free tiers with unlimited recordings. Otter's free tier is 300 minutes per month, which is enough for most individuals but tight for teams.

faq.q: How accurate are AI meeting transcribers?
faq.a: On a clean English-language 1,200-word ground-truth sample, the best tools (Otter, Fireflies) hit a Word Error Rate of 4-5%. Heavy accents, crosstalk, and poor audio push WER into the 10-15% range regardless of vendor.

faq.q: Do AI meeting tools record video?
faq.a: Most do, but policies vary. tl;dv, Fireflies, and Fathom record video by default for paid users; Otter records audio + slides. Always disclose recording to attendees and check local consent laws.

faq.q: Which AI meeting tool is best for sales teams?
faq.a: Fireflies wins for sales because of its native CRM sync (HubSpot, Salesforce, Pipedrive), structured sales-coaching reports, and per-rep analytics. Otter is fine for general meetings but lacks the sales-specific metadata.
